scenario: Nadia filled a prescription at an in-network pharmacy for a medication that has both a brand and a generic version available. Her plan has a $10 generic copay and a $50 brand copay. The pharmacy processed the claim.
policy: A drug claim is paid at the generic tier copay of $10 if a generic equivalent was dispensed. If the brand-name drug was dispensed when a generic was available and no medical-necessity override is on file, the patient pays the brand copay of $50 plus the cost difference.
